mapper.insert: insert into batch.file_group_expectation_definition (tenant_id, calendar_code, workflow_definition_id, file_group_code, expected_local_time, due_local_time, enabled) values (#{tenantId}, #{calendarCode}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{fileGroupCode}, #{expectedLocalTime}, #{dueLocalTime}, #{enabled}) on conflict (tenant_id, calendar_code, workflow_definition_id, file_group_code) do update set workflow_definition_id = excluded.workflow_definition_id, expected_local_time = excluded.expected_local_time, due_local_time = excluded.due_local_time, enabled = excluded.enabled, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: select expectation.tenant_id, expectation.calendar_code, expectation.workflow_definition_id, expectation.file_group_code, expectation.expected_local_time, expectation.due_local_time from batch.file_group_expectation_definition expectation join batch.workflow_definition workflow on workflow.tenant_id = expectation.tenant_id and workflow.id = expectation.workflow_definition_id where expectation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and expectation.calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and expectation.enabled = true and workflow.enabled = true order by expectation.file_group_code, expectation.workflow_definition_id
